components.name: SereniCare AI KTC
components.description: A patient wallet from SereniCare AI: verify your identity with CLEAR or ID.me, and it gathers your records from across the TEFCA network to share at check-in.
components.notes: After you choose Continue, the wallet asks you to verify your identity with CLEAR or ID.me (the home page lists test identities), then fetches records, which can take 5 to 10 minutes. Sandbox, synthetic data only.
